verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of an official SDK is a single line saying users can 'Use the Codex SDK to automate coding tasks, including jobs in CI' [chatgpt-docs-91]. Nothing describes its scope, supported languages, or API surface, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path [chatgpt-probe-3]. Missing for 10: SDK reference documentation, language/package coverage, an SDK covering ChatGPT beyond Codex, a published API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
